zoe_cs: Quick heads-up — SilverLine wants a short APAC demo window tomorrow 09:00 SGT. Staging is throttling their load tests. They asked for a 36h temporary qps bump + CIDR allowlist and region pin to asia-southeast-1. Renewal review in ~8 days, so good outcome matters.

ben_infra: Please paste CIDRs, exact window, model slug and requested qps so I can scope burst. We'll lock grant to the model slug.

zoe_cs: Owner is lucas@silverline.ai. Window: 2026-06-15T23:00Z -> 2026-06-17T11:00Z (36h). Peak qps ~1800, steady ~850. CIDRs: 44.210.10.0/24 and 52.22.0.0/16. Region: asia-southeast-1. Model: sl/demo-lite -> redwood/mini-v1-staging. They also want prefix caching enabled.

ops-bot: @ben_infra created ticket OPS-7444: "SilverLine APAC demo temporary burst + CIDR allow". Approval SLA: 2h. Link: https://redwood.ops/OPS-7444

ben_infra: Reserving a small burst pool and adding CIDRs to proxy allowlist. Kai, can you pre-warm KV cache and bump concurrency? Use batch_max_tokens=320.

kai_se: On it. Warming top-10 prefixes, set concurrency=18, batch_max_tokens=320, prefix_cache TTL=600s. Spinning up a warmed canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: canary/redwood-mini-v1-warm -> asia-southeast-1. ETA ~14m.

ben_infra: Note: limiting grant to that model slug + CIDRs only. Estimated uplift ~$680 for 36h. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-06-17T11:10Z.

maria_ae: cc @zoe_cs I'll capture uplift and demo as renewal momentum if successful; if they request an extension I'll handle AE/legal loop.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed successfully. Warm logs: "kv_cache_hits=94% ; p95=210ms"

zoe_cs: Confirmed with customer: smoke passed at 08:40 SGT, full demo at 09:00 SGT ran clean. AE notified.

ben_infra: OPS-7444 marked provisioned and will auto-revoke per schedule. Reach out here if they ask to extend.

zoe_cs: Closing: demo succeeded, renewal flagged as positive. :white_check_mark:
